format: html

# Load Packages
```{r}
library(Seurat)
library(reticulate)
library(dplyr)
use_condaenv("samflow", required = TRUE)
```

```{python}
import os
os.environ["KMP_WARNINGS"] = "0"
import warnings
warnings.filterwarnings("ignore")

import scanpy as sc
```

# Load Data
```{r}
source("samflow_functions.R")
samflow_load("filtered_feature_bc_matrix/")
```

# View Data
## 1. R
```{r}
head(samflow_obj@meta.data)
```

## 1. Python
```{python}
samflow_obj.obs
```

# Verification
## R Verification
```{r}
# Drop columns in R, then sync R → Python
samflow_obj@meta.data <- samflow_obj@meta.data %>% dplyr::select(orig.ident)
samflow_sync()
```

```{r}
# R should show only orig.ident
head(samflow_obj@meta.data)
```

```{python}
# Python should also show only orig.ident
samflow_obj.obs.head()
```

## Python Verification
```{python}
# Add a column in Python, then sync Python → R
samflow_obj.obs["custom_py_col"] = "hello"
```

```{python}
samflow_obj.obs
```

```{r}
# Trigger Python → R sync
samflow_sync(from = "python")

# R should now have custom_py_col
head(samflow_obj@meta.data)
```
